item.title: Fix bug in window.py so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated chat): "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

Goal: `python3 -m unittest` passes fully. Do not modify any test files. Fix the root cause in `window.py`, and make the function correct for all valid inputs (edge cases such as empty input, boundaries, and window sizes at or beyond the input length), not only the cases the tests cover. Keep the change minimal and readable. Commit the fix on the item's branch with a clear message; do not push.

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in sliding_windows in window.py. The range stopped at len(items) - size, so the last window was never produced. It now uses len(items) - size + 1. Before, python3 -m unittest failed with 2 failures (test_includes_the_last_window, test_whole_list_is_one_window). After, all 3 tests pass. Edge cases checked by probe: empty input returns [], size greater than length returns [], size equal to length returns one window, size 1 returns single-element windows, and size <= 0 still raises ValueError. No test files changed. Committed b43f576 on archon/dc3kq6zy-fix-bug-in-window-py-so-python3-m-unitte, not pushed. Independent reviewer agt_01M7W5JRG6GSV3YH5X4JX6HY91 passed head b43f576 with no blocking findings. Open follow-up (non-blocking): the test suite does not assert empty input or size greater than length; these are correct by probe. No servers or processes were started. Review: PASS, reviewer agt_01M7W5JRG6GSV3YH5X4JX6HY91.

pr.body: Root cause: range(len(items) - size) excluded the final start index. Fix: range(len(items) - size + 1). Edge cases: empty input and size greater than length return [] via range's non-positive count; size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Changed file: window.py only. Checks: python3 -m unittest -v -> Ran 3 tests, OK; edge-case probe output matched expectations. Open follow-up (non-blocking): no test asserts empty input or size > len.
pr.summary: Made sliding_windows return every window, including the last. Now python3 -m unittest passes. Before: last window missing and 2 tests failing; now: all 3 tests pass.
pr.title: Fix off-by-one in sliding_windows that dropped the last window

risk.why: Single-line bounds fix in window.py with no API change; tests confirm the behaviour and the test file is unchanged. Reviewer agt_01M7W5JRG6GSV3YH5X4JX6HY91 confirmed low.
